# Known-debt BASELINE for .github/scripts/check-deploy-coverage.sh — SHRINK-ONLY.
#
# Released components that ArgoCD deploys but nothing builds. These are NOT acceptable;
# they are the debt that existed when the guard was written. The guard exists to stop the
# NEXT one, not to bless these.
#
# This is deliberately a different file from deploy-coverage-allowlist.txt, and the
# distinction is the whole point:
#
#   allowlist  = "something ELSE builds this"      -> permanent, legitimate (admin-ui)
#   baseline   = "NOTHING builds this, yet"        -> debt, must shrink to empty
#
# Collapsing the two would turn the guard into a rubber stamp: every future "we'll wire it
# up later" would land in the same file as a legitimate exception and never be revisited.
# That is how ALL_SERVICES drifted six times over.
#
# RATCHET: the guard FAILS if an entry here is no longer violating — you must delete it.
# It can only ever shrink. Adding an entry is not a fix; it is a deliberate, reviewable
# admission of debt and should be argued for in the PR.
#
# Why these two cannot simply be added to ALL_SERVICES: their ECR repositories do not
# exist, and auto-deploy has no create-repository step, so `docker push` would fail with
# RepositoryNotFoundException. Wiring them up is infra work — tracked in #1205.
#
# One component name per line, exact match.

# finrep-service: released 0.5.0, 25 Kotlin sources, compiles, gitops manifest pinned to the
# ADR-0097 `sandbox-init` placeholder. Never built; ECR repo openbank-finrep-service does not
# exist. Down at 0/1 since its manifest landed. Tracked in #1205.
openbank-finrep-service

# vop-service: released 0.1.0, gitops manifest from #1195 pinned to `sandbox-placeholder`.
# Same shape as finrep, one hour old at the time of writing — which is precisely why this
# guard exists. Tracked in #1205.
openbank-vop-service
